page.layout: One column of running text, with marginal notes in the right margin. Below the text: the signature "E2" at the left and the catchword "à Ca-" at the right.

main_text.p: nunquam hujusmodi confli-ctusHerod. libr. 1. in Orat. particulares inftitui, ut bonam famam in exercitu ho-stiliCommo-di. conservent nostri milites. Ratio est, quia fama plus saepe timoris incutit hosti, quam res aut ratio ipsa. Praevia enim de Regis fortitudine, ejusque militibus opinio, multum poteft in exercitu hostili. Cum nisi quandoque acceptentur oblata illa duella, hostes fiant audaciores, dum existumant, nostros milites aut prae timore, hujusmodi conflictus metuere, aut quod numero destituantur detrectare. Ita in obsidione Da-ventriensi, eques nobilis Alba-nus à partibus Hispanorum quemque ex nostris militibus ad singulare certamen provo-cavit, vetante Principe Mau-ritio, ne quispiam cum eo con-grederetur. Licentiam nihil-Meteran. libr. 16. hiftor. p. mihi. 317. ominus multis precibus im-petravit, nobilis Ludovicus

page.notes: The first line has an ornamental mark in the printed "ho-stili" region only as a typographic dot, not a reference. The printed "Meteran" note spans three lines (libr. 16. / hiftor. p. / mihi. 317.) and is shown as one note. The "E2" signature is printed as "E2" with no space. The catchword "à Ca-" is printed with a trailing hyphen. Some faint specks in the margins and a corner mark at the lower right are not printed text and are omitted.
